description: NVE Atlas (Norwegian natural hazard and energy map service) is a hazard data portal run by Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE). NVE Atlas is the map service through which NVE publishes its map themes; search summaries describe hazard zone maps for landslides in steep terrain (avalanche, slush slide, rockfall, landslide, debris flow), maps for land-use planning, and downloads through Geonorge. Coverage: Norway. Formats and interfaces named: WMS, WFS. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; NVE data on Geonorge is described in a search summary as available as WFS in GML. Caveats: the page is drawn by script and returned no text, so the theme list, formats and licence come from search summaries and are unverified. It can support natural hazard exposure screening of infrastructure in Norway. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
